h1: The 6 Best TV Stands for Bedroom of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best TV Stand for Bedroom 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six bedroom TV stands, from a 31.7 inch cabinet to a nine-drawer dresser TV stand, with size, storage and budget advice.
summary: The WLIVE 58 inch stand is our best overall for a bedroom, with soft-close doors and cable management. The EnHomee dresser is the pick if you need clothes storage, the WLIVE 40 inch cabinet fits tight rooms, and the Furinno is the simplest low-cost option.
intro: Bedroom TV stands fail on height, not width. A living room stand that sits at 25 inches puts the screen above your eye line when you are lying down, so the best bedroom stands tend to be low, around 14 to 18 inches, or double as a dresser.

We reviewed eight stands and ranked six on size, storage, cable handling and what they ask you to give up. Everything comes from the spec sheets, so check the listing dimensions against your wall before buying.

products.name: WLIVE 58" TV Stand for 65 Inch TVs, Mid Century Modern Entertainment Center
products.verdict: A low 18 inch stand that holds up to a 65 inch TV.
products.description:
The WLIVE 58 inch stand measures 58 by 14.6 by 18 inches, fits TVs from 55 to 65 inches, and holds 110 lb on top and 22 lb on its lower shelf. The doors close quietly on magnets, and cable management is built in.

It wins because the 18 inch height keeps the screen low for bed viewing, and the 14.6 inch depth leaves floor space. The 40 inch WLIVE below it trades that screen size for a smaller footprint.

Buy it for a master bedroom with a 55 to 65 inch screen. The caveat is that only the lower shelf has a 22 lb limit.
products.idealFor: Bedrooms with a 55 to 65 inch TV.

products.name: EnHomee 55" Dresser for Bedroom with Charging Station, 65 Inch TV Stand with 9 Fabric Drawers
products.verdict: A TV stand and a dresser in one 55 inch unit.
products.description:
The EnHomee measures 55.12 by 11.81 by 35.43 inches, holds a TV up to 65 inches, and has nine fabric drawers rated 22 lb each. It adds two AC and two USB charging ports, adjustable RGB lighting and anti-tip hardware.

It ranks second because the 35 inch height puts the screen higher than the WLIVE, though it solves clothing storage in the same footprint.

Best for small bedrooms with no room for both. The caveat is the screen sits high for bed viewing.
products.idealFor: Small bedrooms needing storage and a screen.
products.skipIf: You watch from bed and want a low screen.

products.name: WLIVE TV Stand for 40 Inch TVs, Small Entertainment Center with Storage Cabinet
products.verdict: A 31.7 inch cabinet for 32 to 40 inch TVs.
products.description:
This WLIVE stand is 31.7 inches wide, 21.9 inches tall and 15.7 inches deep, fits 32 to 40 inch TVs, and has a three-level adjustable shelf plus cable holes. It sits on tapered mid-century legs.

It ranks third because it is the smallest, which is right for a guest room but limits the TV size compared with the 58 inch model.

For tight rooms. The caveat is the 40 inch TV limit.
products.idealFor: Guest rooms and dorms with a small TV.
products.skipIf: You own a TV above 40 inches.

products.name: Furinno Econ Low Rise TV Stand, Black/Black
products.verdict: A 15 inch tall open stand that keeps the screen low.
products.description:
The Furinno Econ measures 48.7 by 15 by 14.6 inches, holds 60 lb on top, and has stepped three-tier open shelving in FSC-certified composite wood with rounded corners.

It ranks fourth because the lowest height is a big plus for bed viewing, but 60 lb limits big TVs.

Good for a low screen. The caveat is open shelves, which show clutter.
products.idealFor: Bedrooms where the TV sits low.

products.name: Prepac Essentials TV Stand, Black, 60"
products.verdict: A 60 inch stand with four compartments and a 5-year warranty.
products.description:
The Prepac Essentials is 60 by 19.75 by 15.75 inches with a built-in wire management system and four separate storage compartments. It is CARB-compliant composite wood with a 5-year manufacturer warranty, ready to assemble.

It ranks fifth because its 19.75 inch height is a little taller than the WLIVE and the listing offers no top weight rating.

Best for those who value the warranty. The caveat is the missing weight limit.
products.skipIf: You need a stated weight limit.

products.name: Yaheetech TV Stand for TV up to 65 inch, Media Entertainment Center with Power Outlets
products.verdict: Four built-in AC outlets on a 55 inch open stand.
products.description:
The Yaheetech is 55 by 24.5 by 16 inches, fits TVs up to 65 inches, and has four AC ports on a 1500W, 2 meter cord, X-shaped side reinforcement and three open tiers.

It ranks last because 24.5 inches is the tallest here, which puts the screen high for bedside viewing.

Useful where outlets are scarce. The caveat is the height.

methodology.description: Depth and width were weighed against typical bedroom walls.

whatMatters.detail: Height sets where your screen lands relative to your eyes. In a bedroom you often sit or lie lower than in a living room. Look at the height figure in the listing, and aim for roughly 14 to 25 inches for bed viewing.
Listings state the TV sizes they support, such as 55 to 65 inches. Putting a bigger TV on a small stand makes it unstable. Compare your TV's width to the stand's width.
Top capacity is the maximum weight the surface holds, like 110 lb on the WLIVE 58 inch. Check your TV's weight on its spec sheet and stay under the number.
Closed doors hide clutter, drawers hold clothes and open shelves are faster to reach. The choice depends on what you keep nearby. Check the storage description in the title.
Depth is how far the stand sticks out from the wall. In a small bedroom 11 to 16 inches is easier to live with. Look for the D figure in the dimension line.

faq.q: What height is best for a bedroom TV stand?
faq.a: Lower is better for bed viewing. The Furinno at 15 inches and the WLIVE at 18 inches suit it.
Picking a stand by width and ignoring height. A tall stand pushes the screen above your eye line.

faq.q: Is the EnHomee worth it over a plain stand?
faq.a: Yes if you need drawers, since it replaces a dresser. Skip it if you watch from bed.

faq.q: How do I secure a stand?
faq.a: The EnHomee includes anti-tip hardware. For other stands, add your own anchors per the manual.

faq.q: How do I care for the finish?
faq.a: Wipe with a dry or slightly damp cloth and avoid standing water on composite wood.

faq.q: Can a 65 inch TV fit on a 58 inch stand?
faq.a: The WLIVE 58 inch lists 55 to 65 inch TVs, so yes. Check your TV's feet spacing.

finalTake: The WLIVE 58 inch stand is the best bedroom choice for a mid-size TV. Choose the EnHomee when you need storage, the WLIVE 40 inch for a small room, or the Furinno for the lowest screen. Measure height and depth first.
